name: demo-selenium-javascript
summary: A beginner walkthrough demonstrating Selenium WebDriver element-locating strategies and form interactions against https://testingexamples.github.io/en-001/practice/.
description: Demonstrates locating elements by id, name, class name, link text, and XPath, then filling a text input, checking a checkbox, checking a radio button, and selecting a dropdown option, using Selenium WebDriver with ChromeDriver and Node.js.
